ORDINANCE 80-01 TO PROVIDE FOR THE PROHIBITION OF DISCHARGING OF FIREARMS WITHIN THE TOWN OF CLERMONT; TO PROVIDE FOR EXCEPTIONS; TO PROVIDE FOR PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION OF THIS ORDINANCE; TO REPEAL CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT THAT THE CODE OF ORDINANCES FOR THE TOWN OF

CLERMONT, GEORGIA IS HEREBY AMENDED BY ADDING A SECTION TO BE NUMBERED 7-102, WHICH SECTION READS AS FOLLOWS:

"SECTION I. Section 7-102. City Limits: (a) It shall be unlawful for any person to willfully or wantonly fire, shoot off or discharge a firearm within the Town Limits. The provisions of this Section shall not apply to: (1) Persons who shall fire, shoot off, or discharge a firearm in defense of person or property; and (2) Law Enforcement Officers; (b) Any person found guilty of violating the provisions of this Ordinance shall, on conviction thereof, be punished as if the person had committed a misdemeanor under the laws of the State of Georgia by a court of proper jurisdiction. SECTION II. All Ordinances and parts of Ordinances in conflict here with are hereby expressly repealed. SECTION III. This Ordinance shall become effective upon its approval by the Mayor and Council for the Town of Clermont, Georgia.
